study.label: Study
study.thematicDescription: Spring 12-week courses emerging from three fields of study. Open to visiting students (8 places per course). Hosted on rooftop and online.
study.labsDescription: 10–12 week project-based "playful production". Experiment with translation, space, media, and pedagogy. Emphasise experiential learning, welcome all walks of life.
study.workshopsDescription: Short skill/experiment offerings with varied schedules. Focused, hands-on sessions for specific craft or inquiry.
study.featureDescription: One-year flagship liberal arts programme (2 semesters, 15+ hrs/week). Discussion-based, trans-disciplinary coursework across Historical Consciousness, Philosophical & Poetic Inquiry, and Ethnographic Study.

people.label: People
people.fellowsDescription: Teachers who "know how to be a student" — not ones who know answers, but who know how to find out. Graduate-trained, experienced educators attuned to context.
people.cilasiansDescription: Students, alumni, and community members from all walks of life
people.governanceDescription: Advisors and trustees guiding CILAS's mission.
